dimension_description: Information rate measures how quickly symbols, bits, or higher-level messages move through a channel. Some entries here are literal interface or codec rates quoted directly by a standard, while others are derived from a source-side rate such as bytes per second or DNA bases per second. That lets one logarithmic axis connect teletypes, genomes, display links, Ethernet, and modern memory buses.
